Window: prior before 2019-07, [concurrent] 2019-07 to 2020-07, [later] after 2020-07.
population: One filtered decoder population for all topics (tools/pop.py): 611 unique studies (prior 188, [concurrent] 29, date unresolved 4, [later] 390); AVSR subset 265 (prior 89, [concurrent] 7, [later] 169); LRS2 subset 120 (prior 6, [concurrent] 8, unresolved 1, [later] 105).

inherited.M02: GMM-HMM frame alignments of the clean target utterance as labels for overlapped speech (as in Chao et al. 2016); LipNet pre-trained on lip reading
inherited.M03: Multi-condition training on clean plus two-speaker mixtures at 15 to -5 dB; no selection data stated
inherited.M04: Overlapped voiced speech plus the target speaker's mouth ROI at test
inherited.M05: Single-channel 16 kHz audio, 40 log-mel bins; 112x112 mouth ROI upsampled to 100 fps
inherited.M07: 4-gram LM on LRS2 Pre-train transcripts (>2M words)
inherited.M11: LRS2 splits (Pre-train + Train-Val for training); speaker overlap and test-mixture pairing not stated
inherited.M13: No model size, compute or latency, although the integrated model is called compact against a more complex pipeline

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept. For this review: the 89 prior and 7 [concurrent] AVSR decoders of the shared population, classified by full-text pattern (mention counts, reference lists removed) for overlapped or competing-speaker speech, feature concatenation, stream weighting or modality attention, and gated fusion; every overlap hit read in its matching passage to find the decoders actually tested on speech mixtures and their fusion design. Boundary: enhancement or separation studies count only if they run their own recogniser; a study counts under every design its text names; versions once; the target excluded.
topics.metric: two-speaker overlapped LRS2 WER at stated SNR (lower)

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept. For this review: the 6 prior and 8 [concurrent] LRS2 decoders of the shared population (ledger or title names LRS2), classified by full-text pattern for end-to-end objectives (CTC, sequence-to-sequence, encoder-decoder, Transformer), hybrid HMM systems (hybrid DNN or TDNN, GMM-HMM, Kaldi), LF-MMI or sequence training, and a language-model statement. Boundary: keyword spotting removed on reading; versions once; the target excluded.

Published rule kept. For this review: the same 89 prior and 7 [concurrent] AVSR decoders, classified by full-text pattern for stated-SNR tests, babble, overlapped or competing speech, simulated-overlap wording (mixing with an interfering talker, TMR, SIR), run variability or significance, and a language-model statement; overlap and variability hits read. Boundary: versions once; the target excluded.
topics.metric: protocol (test-mixture recipe, clean condition and run variability stated or not)
